title: Spring Follow
description: Chấm dẫn đầu nhảy tới đích bằng lò xo, ba chấm sau đi theo trễ dần, nối bằng một đường mảnh.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio spring-follow, written here): Leader dot x 0 → 180 px on a spring (k 80, c 10, m 1: 12 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~950 ms); three followers on the same spring start 70 / 140 / 210 ms later (opacity 0.82 / 0.64 / 0.46), a thin line linking all four; back to 0 the same way at 1600 ms. Recipe variant: followers 5× stiffer on a damped link, peaks 196 → 193 → 190 → 188, settle 1.4 s. Params: spring (k 80, c 10) · followers: số chấm theo (3) · delay (70 ms) · x (180 px).
